scope: Fresh, guided, targeted physical-junction review of Tingkye PDF6 U182–185, PDF27 U974–977 and PDF32 U1173–1177. Not a translation or complete page/chapter collation.
source_mapping: I1765 image = PDF page +393; printed page = PDF page +385. Printed 391,412,417 visually confirmed.
reviewer_context: Relevant expanded glossary rows: all eight columns reviewed; no English translation or terminology changes proposed.
method: Read the surviving prior claims and base units before inspecting the source; expected text was therefore known.
Extracted native archive images for provider399,420,425 and verified their byte SHA256 against image-manifest.json.
Used pdfimages to extract PDF6,27,32 rasters and verified identical dimensions and decoded grayscale pixels against the archived originals.

Viewed each full page and all seven physical rows for context; performed lexical junction review only on the stated rows. Native unscaled crop views checked both flanks and intervening physical spaces.
No OCR, model-generated image repair, sharpening, inferred missing glyphs, or new facsimile acquisition.

findings.finding: Both verses corresponding to U183 and U184 are present between U182 and U185. The two-verse absence claim is rejected.
findings.source_reading: Row4 right has lha dbang gis ni di skad; row5 opens gsol, followed by an invocation ending bcom ldan das, then di ltar snang ba dam pa nyid, then bsam gyis mi khyab dus pa…
findings.confidence: high for presence/order of the two verses; no exact invocation spelling certification
findings.remaining_uncertainty: Exact opening invocation vowel, number/form of kye syllables, and pa yi/pai spelling in the right flank are outside this presence audit. The retained script supplied expected e ma kye kye; this review does not adopt that expected string as fully authenticated.
findings.recommended_action: Retain U183 and U184 in Adzom; label prior Tingkye absence claim withdrawn. Preserve any recovered old claim only as superseded history.

findings.finding: At the end of U182, gsol is followed by punctuation and the invocation; no nas syllable intervenes at this junction.
findings.source_reading: Row4-right di skad continues with row5-left gsol. After its punctuation, the next syllables begin the invocation.
findings.confidence: high for the bounded gsol-to-invocation junction
findings.remaining_uncertainty: Invocation orthography remains qualified in TK-REC-20260927-001. This finding does not certify unrelated lexical records from the lost report.
findings.recommended_action: Withdraw the claimed Tingkye gsol nas addition at U182. Do not insert nas into the governing base.

findings.finding: The U974 phrase is directly followed by U976 in row3; U975 is absent at that junction. U977 begins at row3 right and continues at row4 left.
findings.source_reading_ewts: de 'das nga yis bzung ba yis / sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis ni / 'di la [row break] brten nas nges par 'byung
findings.confidence: high for this local sequence and absence
findings.remaining_uncertainty: No global absence elsewhere, displaced occurrence, exhaustive glyph comparison, or punctuation equivalence is certified.
findings.recommended_action: Record U975 as locally absent in Tingkye at PDF27 row3, retaining both physical flanks. Retain Adzom U975 unchanged.

findings.finding: U1173 begins with nyon at row3 end and continues mongs…phyir at row4 left. It proceeds directly to U1176, followed by U1177. Both U1174 and U1175 are absent at that junction.
findings.source_reading_ewts: dus kyi rim pa drug cu 'byung / nyon [row break] mongs las dbang gzhan 'gyur phyir / 'dzam bu gling pa rnams la yang / brgya yi bar la dus rim ni
findings.confidence: high for this local sequence and two-verse absence
findings.remaining_uncertainty: Exact fine-letter and punctuation equivalence outside the identifying phrases, global absence and displacement elsewhere are not certified.
findings.recommended_action: Index both U1174 and U1175 in the Tingkye local gap finding. Retain both Adzom verses unchanged.

coverage.disposition: Targeted presence/absence questions resolved with listed orthographic limits; Chapter1 remains incomplete.

limitations: Four findings concern three junctions; the two PDF6 findings share the same evidence and are not independent witness votes.
The lost full Tingkye continuation and original claim snapshots are not recovered by this review.
Previous exact invocation transcription is not promoted to certainty. Presence of a verse can be established without certifying every grapheme.
No global witness omission, source reconstruction, all-punctuation certificate or chapter-completion claim.
mutations: Only this new report and its evidence were created. Canonical apparatus, source, glossary and rendered chapter were unchanged.
